*This course has been merged into **[The Golden Dawn — the Map and the Walk](https://recursive.eco/play?id=9befd48e-5c83-48aa-abb2-d865beb06c19&pane=continuous)** — where who the Order were, the address every card carries, the thirty-six decans and their titles, the two ways the Order used the deck, the Rider-Waite-Smith origin story and the further reading all live now, beside the pathworking practice they belong with.*
